stem.text: The reaction pathway diagram for a chemical reaction is shown.

stem.alt: Energy profile: energy against progress of reaction; a single peak between a lower reactant level and a higher product level.

A.text: The activation energy of the forward reaction and the enthalpy change of the backward reaction have the same sign.

B.text: The activation energy of the forward reaction is more than twice the enthalpy change of the backward reaction and opposite in sign.

C.text: The enthalpy change of the forward reaction and the activation energy of the backward reaction have the same sign.

D.text: The enthalpy change of the forward reaction is more than twice the activation energy of the backward reaction.
